title: Prisma Neon adapter: onError handler crashes on connection pool exhaustion

error_signal.message: prisma Error: connection pool timeout in neon adapter onError - unable to acquire connection from pool within timeout

ground_truth.root_cause_description: Neon adapter connection pool exhaustion. The onError handler in neon.ts receives pool timeout errors but the pool configuration or connection lifecycle is the actual issue.
ground_truth.fix_description: Increase pool size or add connection timeout configuration in the Neon adapter
